cap: Fast GnRH pulses favor LH, which drives theca androgen production, and insulin resistance adds more androgen while lowering SHBG, so free testosterone rises. Low FSH and local androgen stall follicles, so none becomes dominant and no corpus luteum forms. Without progesterone, estrogen, including estrone made from androgen in fat, acts on the endometrium unopposed, which explains irregular bleeding and the risk of hyperplasia and cancer.
